title: Bank transfer payment
waitingOrder: Verifying the order. Do not transfer until the details are ready.
noSession: This order has no online payment session. Do not pay using an old QR or sample bank account.
noTransferOnError: The latest balance could not be verified. Wait for a refresh before transferring more.
scanHint: Scan with your banking app. Payment updates automatically.
confirming: Full payment received; waiting for order confirmation. Do not transfer more.
localSimulationNotice: Local testing only. This creates a simulated transaction; no real money moves.
deadline: Keep the reference unchanged. The 15-minute deadline does not reset on reload; do not transfer after expiry.
refundUnavailable: These funds need store review and have not been automatically refunded. Please contact the store.

statuses.COLLECTED: The store accepted collection. Declared transfers may still await bank reconciliation. Do not transfer more.
statuses.LEGACY_REVIEW: This older payment needs snapshot review. Do not transfer more or reuse an old QR; contact the store.
statuses.PENDING: Waiting for the full transfer amount.
statuses.EXPIRED: Payment expired. Do not transfer more or reuse this QR.
statuses.CANCELLED: Order cancelled. Do not transfer more; received funds are retained for review.
